subject: Update on your application: Analytics Lead
summary: Brightline Recruiting rejected Alex's application for the Analytics Lead role and will keep details on file.
reason: A rejection needs no action, but is worth a glance so the application can be closed out.

messages.body_text: Hi Alex, thank you for your time. After careful consideration we've decided to move forward with other candidates for the Analytics Lead role. We'll keep your details on file.
